Subject (in full) Ching Pao (Intelligence) - Seizure by Police

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Acting on instructions of D. C. (Special Branch)
appended to attached report, 12 copies of the Ching Pao
(Intelligence 情報), an unregistered publication
dated August 20, 1940, were seized by C.D.C. 230, Chang
Yeh, on August 27 and 28 from various book-stalls in
Nanking Road, Chekiang Road, Avenue Edward VII, Yu Ya
Ching Road, Shantung Road and Chengtu Road. The
seized copies are now held in the office of S. 5.
No copies of this publication have been noticed
on public sale at local bookstores.

FILE

D. C. (Special Branch).

J. A. Young
D. S. I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S. 5, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date Aug. 27, 19 40.
Subject (in full) Ching Pao (Intelligence) - Unregistered publication on
sale locally
Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

The attached translation of extracts is taken
from an unregistered publication known as the Ching
Pao (Intelligence 情報), Issue No.2, dated
August 20, 1940, and is forwarded herewith, pending
instructions of D.C. (Special Branch).
The attached copy was obtained by C.D.C. 230
Chang Yeh this morning from one Mei Kuo-cheng (梅國正),
a newsvendor in Shantung Road, who stated that he had
received 200 copies of this publication from a person
representing the Shing Chien Yueh Kan (兴建月刊),
a pro-Wang Ching-wei publication, registered with the
S.M. Police under No.C. 646 and had distributed them
for sale to various other newsvendors in the Settlement.
According to the back cover of the publication,
the Ching Pao is published by the Ching Pao Publishing
Society, no address being given.

D. C. (Special Branch).    D. S. I. Young.

制作人：副督察杨（Young） 转呈人：梅森警司（Supt. Mason）

所附译文摘录自一份名为《情报》（Intelligence 情報）的未注册出版物，该刊为1940年8月20日出版的第2期，现随文呈送，以待特务科助理总监的指示。
所附副本由刑事侦缉处第230号警员张业（Chang Yeh）于今晨从山东路的一名报贩梅国正（Mei Kuo-cheng）处获得，该报贩称他从一名代表《兴建月刊》（Shing Chien Yueh Kan）的人士那里收到了200份该出版物，《兴建月刊》是一份亲汪精卫的出版物，已在工部局警务处注册，注册号为C. 646，并将这些出版物分发给租界内的其他报贩进行销售。
根据该出版物的封底，《情报》由《情报》出版社出版，未提供地址。

特务科助理总监。    副督察杨（Young）。

pages.en:
Translation of extracts from article entitled "Gentlemen and
Clowns" appearing in Issue No.2 of Ching Pao (Intelligence)
dated August 20, 1940.

Page 4

The disorderly condition and signs of fall of the
British and French Imperialism in the existing war against
Germany have become universally known.
They were gentlemen in the past, but have become clowns
of to-day, which fact actually makes one laugh.
The Foreign Settlements in Shanghai have been used by
British and French Imperialism as bases in the Far East.
The gentlemen used to do things sometimes severe and sometimes
lenient in this dirty land and look upon Chinese as nothing.
Who knows that in this war they have heavily lost face in the
eyes of the public.

Recently several newspapers having relations with
Chungking strongly criticized the action of Britain and France
in yielding to Japan. Although they knew full well that the
submissive act of their own governments was definitely a fact
the authorities of the two Foreign Settlements, in order to
maintain their colonial masks, could not but call responsible
persons of various newspapers and request them to refrain from
publishing news relating to such a submissive act. The
responsible persons however replied that such news was mostly
disseminated by Reuters and Havas and that it had better ask
these news agencies not to issue it.

The collapse of British and French Imperialism in their
various colonies throughout the world is becoming near and
nearer. In the past the gentlemen used to be haughty in manner,
but now when they flee into air-raid shelters, all become clowns.
Despite the fact that there are no air-raid shelters in Shanghai
for them to hide, the expression of clowns is found all the
same.
pages.zh:
1940年8月20日出版的《情报》（Intelligence）第2期中题为“君子与丑角”的文章摘录译文。

第4页

英法帝国主义在当前对德战争中混乱不堪且显露败象，这已众所周知。
他们过去是君子，如今却成了丑角，这一事实实在令人发笑。
上海的公共租界曾被英法帝国主义用作其在远东的基地。
那些君子在这片肮脏的土地上行事时而严厉时而宽纵，视中国人如草芥。
谁知在这场战争中，他们在公众面前大大丢了脸。

最近，几家与重庆方面有关系的报纸强烈批评英法向日本屈服的行为。尽管两租界当局完全清楚其本国政府的屈从行为确是事实，但为了维持其殖民面具，不得不召见各报社负责人，要求他们停止刊登有关此类屈从行为的新闻。然而，这些负责人回答说，此类消息大多由路透社和哈瓦斯社发布，最好去要求这些通讯社不要发布。

英法帝国主义在世界各地的殖民地崩溃之日已越来越近。过去，那些君子态度傲慢，但现在当他们逃入防空洞时，全都变成了丑角。尽管上海并没有供他们躲藏的防空洞，但丑角的嘴脸依然暴露无遗。
